items.title: Disable the engine-room trap

items.details:
Use the USP collected after Olga, not the tranquilizer M9: the small control units must be physically destroyed. Stop before the laser boundary and inspect the corridor from different heights in first person. Shoot the control units rather than the explosive blocks.

A missing unit can be obscured from your first position, so shift your view instead of crossing to investigate. Advance only after the laser trap is disabled; this is a disarming puzzle, not a test of running through quickly.

details_i18n.en:
Use the USP collected after Olga, not the tranquilizer M9: the small control units must be physically destroyed. Stop before the laser boundary and inspect the corridor from different heights in first person. Shoot the control units rather than the explosive blocks.

A missing unit can be obscured from your first position, so shift your view instead of crossing to investigate. Advance only after the laser trap is disabled; this is a disarming puzzle, not a test of running through quickly.
details_i18n.pt:
Use a USP obtida após Olga, não a M9 tranquilizante: os pequenos controles precisam ser destruídos. Pare antes dos feixes e examine o corredor em primeira pessoa por diferentes alturas. Atire nos controles, não nos blocos explosivos.

Um controle pode estar escondido no primeiro ângulo; mude a visão em vez de atravessar para procurar. Só avance depois de desativar a armadilha. É um puzzle de desarme, não uma passagem para atravessar correndo.

items.title: Upload the four required photographs

items.description: Use the hold's computer terminal and let Otacon check the evidence; retake any rejected angle before continuing to the Tanker ending.

items.details:
The required set is four distinct photographs: RAY from the front, front-left and front-right, plus a readable close-up of the MARINES marking. Move to each angle; rotating the camera from one spot does not guarantee a different accepted view. Keep the robot clearly framed and avoid filling the image with a Marine.

Check your stored shots before using the terminal so you do not overwrite a needed angle. Let Otacon review the upload, then retake only the missing or rejected views and submit again.

details_i18n.en:
The required set is four distinct photographs: RAY from the front, front-left and front-right, plus a readable close-up of the MARINES marking. Move to each angle; rotating the camera from one spot does not guarantee a different accepted view. Keep the robot clearly framed and avoid filling the image with a Marine.

Check your stored shots before using the terminal so you do not overwrite a needed angle. Let Otacon review the upload, then retake only the missing or rejected views and submit again.
details_i18n.pt:
O conjunto exigido tem quatro fotos diferentes: RAY de frente, diagonal esquerda e diagonal direita, mais um enquadramento legível da inscrição MARINES. Vá até cada ângulo; apenas girar a câmera no mesmo lugar não garante outra vista aceita. Enquadre bem o robô e evite preencher a imagem com um soldado.

Confira as fotos armazenadas antes de usar o terminal para não sobrescrever um ângulo necessário. Deixe Otacon analisar o envio e refaça as vistas ausentes ou recusadas antes de enviar novamente.

items.details:
This device is different from the scented C4 in the earlier assignment. Retrieve Sensor B from Stillman's storage room in Strut C, then return to the Strut A sea dock where Raiden began. Equip Sensor B and use its changing sound to narrow down the target beneath the dock structure.

Get a clear spraying angle without entering the water, switch to Coolant and keep spraying until the device is completely frozen. If the timer is tight, follow the direct route and leave optional rooms for later.

details_i18n.en:
This device is different from the scented C4 in the earlier assignment. Retrieve Sensor B from Stillman's storage room in Strut C, then return to the Strut A sea dock where Raiden began. Equip Sensor B and use its changing sound to narrow down the target beneath the dock structure.

Get a clear spraying angle without entering the water, switch to Coolant and keep spraying until the device is completely frozen. If the timer is tight, follow the direct route and leave optional rooms for later.
details_i18n.pt:
Este dispositivo é diferente dos C4 com cheiro da tarefa anterior. Pegue o Sensor B no depósito de Stillman em Strut C e volte ao cais de Strut A, onde Raiden começou. Equipe o Sensor B e use a mudança no som para localizar o alvo sob a estrutura do cais.

Procure um ângulo livre para borrifar sem entrar na água, troque para Coolant e continue até congelar completamente o dispositivo. Se o tempo estiver curto, siga direto e deixe as salas opcionais para depois.

items.details:
The countdown continues after Fatman falls. Equip Coolant before searching. Grab his body and move it far enough to reveal the C4 beneath him, then let go and crouch if necessary to spray the device. Keep spraying until the bomb is fully frozen.

Collect optional items only after the timer is gone; picking up a dog tag does not disarm the bomb.

details_i18n.en:
The countdown continues after Fatman falls. Equip Coolant before searching. Grab his body and move it far enough to reveal the C4 beneath him, then let go and crouch if necessary to spray the device. Keep spraying until the bomb is fully frozen.

Collect optional items only after the timer is gone; picking up a dog tag does not disarm the bomb.
details_i18n.pt:
A contagem continua depois que Fatman cai. Equipe Coolant antes de procurar. Segure o corpo e mova-o o suficiente para revelar o C4 embaixo dele; solte-o e agache, se necessário, para borrifar o dispositivo. Continue até a bomba ficar completamente congelada.

Pegue os itens opcionais depois que o cronômetro sumir; recolher uma dog tag não desarma a bomba.

items.details:
Enter the hostage area with the B.D.U. disguise and AKS-74u prepared. The Directional Microphone is in Shell 1 Core B2; bring it to B1 and listen to hostages individually. Ames has an electronic pacemaker sound mixed with his heartbeat, so identify the sound rather than assuming a fixed seat.

Keep the microphone aimed at the matching hostage and use the action command to call him. Watch the patrolling guard while searching. During the later warning, restore the AKS-74u promptly so the missing rifle does not expose your disguise.

details_i18n.en:
Enter the hostage area with the B.D.U. disguise and AKS-74u prepared. The Directional Microphone is in Shell 1 Core B2; bring it to B1 and listen to hostages individually. Ames has an electronic pacemaker sound mixed with his heartbeat, so identify the sound rather than assuming a fixed seat.

Keep the microphone aimed at the matching hostage and use the action command to call him. Watch the patrolling guard while searching. During the later warning, restore the AKS-74u promptly so the missing rifle does not expose your disguise.
details_i18n.pt:
Entre na área dos reféns com o disfarce B.D.U. e a AKS-74u preparados. O Microfone Direcional fica em Shell 1 Core B2; leve-o ao B1 e escute cada refém. Ames tem um som eletrônico de marca-passo junto das batidas, portanto identifique o som em vez de presumir uma cadeira fixa.

Mantenha o microfone apontado ao refém correto e use o comando de ação para chamá-lo. Observe o guarda durante a busca. No aviso posterior, reequipe a AKS-74u rapidamente para a ausência do rifle não denunciar o disfarce.

details_i18n.en:

If the trap remains active, scan again from a different angle instead of walking into the wires. Their placement can vary with difficulty, so use the scene itself rather than a fixed count.
details_i18n.pt:

items.details:
Remain on the safe side of the electrified floor. With the Nikita, launch toward the ventilation opening and steer through the duct until the missile reaches the room with the electrical panel. The objective is the panel, not the President; avoid his position and do not fire blindly into him.

If a missile hits the duct wall, adjust the launch position and make slower turns. Once the control panel is destroyed, leave the missile view and confirm the electricity is off before walking across.

details_i18n.en:
Remain on the safe side of the electrified floor. With the Nikita, launch toward the ventilation opening and steer through the duct until the missile reaches the room with the electrical panel. The objective is the panel, not the President; avoid his position and do not fire blindly into him.

If a missile hits the duct wall, adjust the launch position and make slower turns. Once the control panel is destroyed, leave the missile view and confirm the electricity is off before walking across.
details_i18n.pt:
Fique no lado seguro do piso eletrificado. Com a Nikita, dispare em direção à abertura de ventilação e conduza pelo duto até a sala do painel elétrico. O alvo é o painel, não o presidente; evite a posição dele e não atire às cegas contra seu corpo.

Se o míssil bater no duto, ajuste a posição do disparo e faça curvas mais lentas. Após destruir o painel, saia da visão do míssil e confirme que a eletricidade desligou antes de atravessar.

items.details:

Stop firing when Emma blocks the angle, reacquire Vamp and shoot during the next opening. This encounter is an accuracy check rather than a reason to spray ammunition; the later story scene is not evidence that you should shoot Emma.

details_i18n.en:
Use the sniper rifle from your covering position and steady the scope before committing to the shot. Vamp is partly hidden behind Emma; track his exposed head and wait for a clean separation. A shot at the center of the combined silhouettes can hit the person you are protecting.

Stop firing when Emma blocks the angle, reacquire Vamp and shoot during the next opening. This encounter is an accuracy check rather than a reason to spray ammunition; the later story scene is not evidence that you should shoot Emma.
details_i18n.pt:
Use o rifle de precisão da posição de cobertura e estabilize a mira antes de disparar. Vamp fica parcialmente escondido atrás de Emma; acompanhe a cabeça exposta e espere uma separação clara. Um tiro no centro das duas silhuetas pode acertar quem você está protegendo.

description_i18n.en: Lock on to a knee and fire, then aim at the opened mouth for the damaging follow-up.

items.details:
Treat each opening as a two-shot sequence: lock the Stinger onto a knee, fire to make the RAY stagger, then shift the target to its opened mouth and fire again. A knee hit creates the opening; repeatedly hitting armor without the mouth follow-up wastes opportunities.

Leave the aiming view to dodge incoming attacks, then rebuild the sequence. Watch the other RAYs as well as the one on the platform. The number you must defeat varies with difficulty, so continue until the encounter itself advances.

details_i18n.en:
Treat each opening as a two-shot sequence: lock the Stinger onto a knee, fire to make the RAY stagger, then shift the target to its opened mouth and fire again. A knee hit creates the opening; repeatedly hitting armor without the mouth follow-up wastes opportunities.

Leave the aiming view to dodge incoming attacks, then rebuild the sequence. Watch the other RAYs as well as the one on the platform. The number you must defeat varies with difficulty, so continue until the encounter itself advances.
details_i18n.pt:
Trate cada abertura como uma sequência de dois tiros: trave o Stinger num joelho, dispare para desequilibrar o RAY, mude o alvo para a boca aberta e atire de novo. O acerto no joelho cria a abertura; insistir na armadura sem aproveitar a boca desperdiça oportunidades.

Saia da mira para desviar dos ataques e recomece a sequência. Observe também os outros RAYs, não apenas o da plataforma. A quantidade exigida muda com a dificuldade; continue até o próprio encontro avançar.
